title: Stripe header
description: Light, transparent header: a bold lowercase wordmark, plain navy nav links with small chevrons, a white shadowed sign-in button and an indigo action. On phones a white square burger opens a floating menu card.
notes: transparent by default so the hero's ribbon shows behind it (stripe-hero reaches up under it)
static: it scrolls away with the page; the chevrons are decoration, not dropdowns
name: stripe-header

props.name: brand
props.description: the wordmark; also the home link's label

props.name: logo
props.description: optional logo shown instead of the text wordmark (an svg or img)

props.name: secondary
props.description: quiet white button before the main action (e.g. sign in)

props.name: primary
props.description: the indigo button at the right end

props.name: menuLabel
props.description: label of the phone menu button, for screen readers

props.name: transparent
props.description: transparent lets the next block's art show behind the header (as on the original)
